RULES
Name every file with its type and version. Never move a character file into a workflow folder; link it from here. Duplicates are never deleted: the older copy is renamed *_superseded_<HHMM> and moved to Archive. Each change is recorded in this doc's change log, in CUSTOM_HERO_STATE.md, in the Notion page and in the Linear project.
